title: Renting a Boat in Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **Anyone can rent a motorboat up to 15 hp in Berlin without a licence.** The catch is where it may go: the Spree between the Kanzleramtssteg and the Oberbaumbruecke, the whole stretch past the Reichstag and Museum Island, is closed to licence-free boats, kayaks and SUP boards all year.

**Licence-free boating lives in the southeast.** The rental bases sit around Koepenick, the Dahme and the Mueggelsee. A day boat for up to six people starts at about **180 EUR on a weekday**, with fuel and a cash deposit on top.

**Paddling is the cheap way in.** Kayaks and SUP boards cost about **15 EUR per hour** at Treptower Park, and the Landwehrkanal is open to paddlers in both directions at a 6 km/h pace. From the east you can paddle up to the Oberbaumbruecke, but not past it.
**If you want Museum Island from the water, take the guided cruise.** A one hour city round trip costs about **22.50 EUR** and is the only realistic way through the closed Mitte stretch.
**Swimming in the inner-city Spree and canals is banned**, and the water police patrol the closed zone. Rules checked on 30 August 2026.
